verdict.rationale: Fathom's own docs confirm it automatically generates AI action items from meetings, and they can be included in webhook payloads. The evidence never shows action items assigned to owners, and never shows an in-product place to collect and track them; webhook delivery to your own URL is only a building block for that. Missing for 10: documented owner/assignee attribution on action items, a first-party tracking or aggregation view for action items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
